suggestions.roleTitleVi: Chuyên viên Giải pháp AI & Kiến trúc Luồng Tự động hóa
suggestions.reasoning: As manual software QA roles experience a declining demand signal with standard CRUD tests heavily automated (OpenAI/UPenn 2023, VietnamWorks 2024), transitioning into AI solutions and workflow architecture offers high-growth potential. According to TopCV Vietnam (2024), there is a 180% surge in enterprise demand for AI Workflow Integrators with salaries exceeding 35M - 60M VND/month, aligning with Kiet's preference for remote flexibility and stability.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: Your strong foundation in manual software QA, edge-case analytical thinking, and Agile process experience provide a solid base for designing robust quality frameworks and system workflows. While you have less experience writing automation code from scratch and benchmark LLMs, your structured testing mindset is an incredible asset for setting up AI safety guardrails and evaluating model hallucinations.
transferableSkillsMatch: Deep edge-case testing mindset and bug tracking
Agile/Scrum process navigation and cross-functional communication
Detailed bug report synthesis and documentation clarity
skillsGap: Hands-on Python test automation and API integration
LLM prompt system design and performance benchmarking
